trigger_rule: First non-bootstrap FRESH observation east of exit plane, west of start X + original radius, within inner half of proposed 1.5m southern approach band, facing and moving north, before any measured corner entry. No request ID or prediction-content criterion.
intervention: One post-response application hold on integer 60Hz physics ticks, retaining OLD command and wheels; no sleep-based delay, no additional capture or inference during hold.
stop_rule: Two zero-delay controls must pass original left-turn/west-hallway and goal gates without nonfloor contact. Ascending delays, two independent trials per level, no retries. Stop larger delays if both trials clearly fail the corner after both preceding-level trials passed, or on runtime/inference failure. Mixed navigation outcomes remain mixed; never extend beyond1s.
during_hold_contact: Stop safely on actual environment nonfloor contact (original abs(normal.z)<0.5 convention), preserve unapplied response and partial trace.
corner_metric_window: From first dense measured crossing of trigger band's south Y to original corner completion, first nonfloor contact or run end, whichever comes first. No fabricated passage time on failure.
clearance_note: Original circumscribed disk vs structural world AABBs plus saved PhysX ray proxy, separate from measured contact; no exact recoverability oracle.
curvature_note: Measured body yaw rate / measured XY speed, radius=1/abs(curvature), undefined if speed or abs yaw rate <= original1e-6 numerical floor. Not native yaw or minimum feasible turning radius.
